ABOUT

Year 10 student in London pursuing AQA Higher Sciences, Edexcel Maths Higher, and OCR Computer Science. I learn by building: web apps, AI tools, automation scripts, server and homelab projects, and training analytics systems that connect sport, data, and performance.

Competitive cycling at national and international level has taught me that useful engineering needs both analytical precision and disciplined execution: measure carefully, improve quickly, and do the hard work consistently.
